identityRules.description: In-house app whose exe has no publisher in its file info. The empty publisher means: this exe, with no publisher.
Version range: builds 8.x of designer.exe belong to the older product. It comes before c-designer-1 because the first matching rule wins. A range matches only a build whose facts were verified.
Fixes a wrong match: credit designer.exe from Fabrikam to Fabrikam Designer, not to the Fabrikam Suite it ships with. Customer rules always win.

classificationRules.description: Not an app: the kiosk shell that starts at sign-in. An ignored exe never counts as use of an app, and is not one of its app's known exes, so an app whose only exe is ignored reads NotCovered, never NotUsed.
Background agent: report it as a helper, not as app use.
